sources.title: Triton TPB-4N board
published_facts: Nominal 1/4-inch board thickness and round holes

design_decisions: 4.8 mm rounded upper section, slightly below the published 5.08 mm steel diameter to allow printed fit tolerance
A 45-degree terminal tip with a 3 mm centerline blend radius; chosen after insertion motion checks, not copied from unpublished Amazon dimensions
6.7 mm neck distance to the start of the bend, for nominal 6.35 mm board
3.4 mm tapered terminal diameter for easier entry
5.6 mm lower locating pin, 4.8 mm reach, one inch below upper peg, 3-degree offset
4.4 mm body depth with flat printing face; original front key hook retained
No commercial steel load rating applies to this PLA prototype
